# ”Marknaden vill verkligen se kassaflöden”

**Feed**: efn-borsfrukost  
**Published**: 2026-10-29  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

EFN morning show from 29 October 2026: the Fed left rates unchanged, with two members dissenting in favour of a hike, and big-tech earnings split the field. Microsoft rose on strong Azure growth, while Alphabet fell about 10% on weak search revenue and worse free cash flow. Oracle jumped 12% on an earlier free-cash-flow target, which is the episode's theme that the market now rewards cash flows. On the Nordic side, Sweco's Q3 was mixed and Kongsberg's order intake was very strong, plus EFN buy ratings on Sandvik, ABB and Lundin Mining.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 SAND — Sandvik | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

EFN gave it a buy rating yesterday; analysis on efn.se.

#### Reasoning

This is a buy rating from EFN's own analysts, cited by the hosts. No supporting detail was given in this segment.

#### Sell Triggers

- if EFN withdraws the buy rating
- if the industrial cycle weakens

> *"Sandvik har EFN köpstämplat under gårdagen."*

### 🟢 LUMI — Lundin Mining | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Has received a buy rating; hosts say it is worth watching.

#### Reasoning

A buy rating is cited, with no source named. The hosts call it worth keeping an eye on but give no details of the case.

- if metal prices fall
- if the buy rating is withdrawn

> *"Annars är det värt att hålla koll på Lundin Mining som fått en köpstämpel."*

---

### 🟠 SIVE — Sivers Semiconductors | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Marvell in advanced talks to buy US peer Lumentum; a peer bid could benefit Sivers.

#### Reasoning

The host speculates that M&A interest in the peer Lumentum could lift Sivers because they have traded in the same basket. He stresses that Lumentum is many times larger, so this is a speculative, short-term catalyst.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Marvell-Lumentum talks collapse
- if no sector re-rating follows

> *"att den nu eventuellt kan komma ett bud på en peer är ju något de skulle kunna gynna den före detta svenska Hype aktien"*

---

### 🟠 KOG.OL — Kongsberg Gruppen | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 60%

Order intake 23.3bn vs 17.4bn expected (~35% beat); sales and earnings above expectations.

#### Reasoning

The host calls it a very strong report with a big beat on order intake plus better sales and earnings. He expects a positive share reaction, supported by strong defence demand.

#### Sell Triggers

- if defence order momentum fades
- if the stock falls despite the beat

> *"Det kan vi nog få se en positiv reaktion på."*

---

### ⛔ GOOGL — Alphabet | **AVOID** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Missed nearly across the board; weaker search; FCF -9.6bn vs -3.5bn expected; stock down ~10%.

#### Reasoning

The hosts see AI chatbots eating into search revenue, which makes the AI capex harder to carry while the market demands cash flow. They also raise talent drain away from search as an underrated risk. There is no explicit recommendation, but the tone is negative.

#### Sell Triggers

- if search revenue re-accelerates
- if FCF improves toward expectations

> *"Däremot så bommar man nästan över hela linjen på resten av rapporten."*

---

### 🟠 ORCL — Oracle | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Up 12% on guidance of $30bn FCF by FY2029, a year earlier than expected.

#### Reasoning

The market rewards visible cash flows. Oracle was the most questioned of the AI giants, so the earlier FCF target lowers its perceived risk and supports the whole AI trade.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the FCF guidance is cut
- if neocloud counterparty risk materialises

> *"Så att få höra att det ändå ser hyfsat stabilt ut från Oracle är väl någonting som borde ge lite trygghet i hela AI-traden."*
